findings.title: Recheck the cache after acquiring the write lock
findings.body: Concurrent production requests arriving before the cache is populated all observe a nil cache under the read lock, then queue for the write lock. Because the cache is not checked again after acquiring that lock, every queued request rereads and parses assets-manifest.json serially even after the first request has successfully populated the cache. This turns a cold-start request burst into repeated serialized disk I/O and delays all queued requests unnecessarily. After acquiring the write lock, return the populated cache when cfg.Env is not setting.Dev before loading the manifest.
